title: Contract Paralegal
description:
The Role

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a Contract Paralegal. This is a full-time, fixed-term contract for 3-6 months. The role is based in a Bristol office and is on-site.

You will manage fee-earning case work end to end and take responsibility for your own allocated matters, working within resourcing thresholds and under supervision. You will support case progression, client service, and financial accuracy while contributing to continuous improvement within the team.

Responsibilities will include
- Manage fee-earning end-to-end case work and take ownership of allocated matters under supervision.
- Prepare documentation and liaise with clients, customers, and third parties to progress cases within SLA.
- Draft correspondence and review incoming correspondence from third parties.
- Manage key dates and deadlines accurately.
- Update the Peppermint system to ensure data capture and MI reporting are accurate.
- Deliver excellent client service through effective case management.
- Manage matters financially with strong attention to billing and financial hygiene.
- Support continuous improvement and change initiatives within the team.
- Work within regulatory and industry frameworks, policies, and procedures.
- Maintain a positive culture and act as a role model within the team.

The Person

The successful candidate will be organised, accurate, and confident managing a busy caseload. You will have a strong client-service approach and the ability to work well under supervision while taking responsibility for your own matters.
- Experience in paralegal or fee-earning casework is desirable or a legal degree
- Strong written communication skills, including drafting correspondence.
- Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage deadlines, key dates, and financial processes.
- Confident using case management systems and working within set procedures.

The Hours

Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm

The Salary

£26,500.

The Contract:

3-6 months

The Location:

Central Bristol, no car parking

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal
- Annual Salary: To be discussed
- Location: Bristol
- Job Type: Hybrid (2 days in office)

We are seeking an experienced Personal Injury Case Handler to join our client's claimant injury department. The successful candidate will manage a diverse caseload involving a variety of injury claims, including those involving vulnerable road users and minor to moderate head injuries. This role requires a combination of office and home working, with 2 days per week spent in our clients Bristol office.

PLEASE NOTE: MUST HAVE LITIGATION/PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE AND BE ABLE TO CARRY A CASELOAD INDEPENDENTLY TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Efficiently and effectively manage your own caseload of personal injury claims.
- Pursue claims up to a value of £25,000.00 through and outside of the MOJ Portal, including pre and post litigation stages, making full use of our case management system.
- Comply fully with agreed service standards.
- Communicate with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, and solicitors.
- Attend and participate in weekly risk assessment meetings.
- Manage client expectations and effectively deal with any complaints that arise in line with company policy.
- Perform any other duties as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience handling a claimant injury caseload.
- Working knowledge of MOJ Portal processes.
- Experience pursuing claims allocated to the Fast Track.
- Experience of litigation including the issue of proceedings, complying with Court Directions through to Trial.
- Knowledge of a Case Management System.
- Ability to work to strict Service Level Agreements.
- Technical proficiency in claims handling including litigation.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to analyse and research legal issues.
- Ability to organise and prioritise work.
- Ability to work as part of a team.
- Law degree, CILEx, or equivalent qualification desirable but not essential.

Benefits:
- Excellent annual leave & welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan & gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Work-life balance & dress for your day.
- People-focused recognition & referral schemes.
- Development & routes to qualification.
- Diversity & sustainability initiatives.

A successful offer of employment is subject to a basic credit check and a basic DBS check.

We are committed to creating an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you encounter any barriers or need support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition & Resourcing team at

To apply for this Personal Injury Case Handler position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience.

title: Personal Injury Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal

Bristol

Salary up to £30,000 DOE

Yolk Recruitment is supporting a highly regarded national law firm with the recruitment of an experienced Personal Injury Paralegal to join its established claimant injury team in Bristol. This is an excellent opportunity for a Personal Injury Paralegal or experienced PI Case Handler who is confident managing their own caseload and wants to develop their career within a supportive and well-established legal environment.

The successful Personal Injury Paralegal will manage a varied caseload of injury claims, including matters involving vulnerable road users such as cyclists, pedestrians and motorcyclists, alongside minor to moderate head injury claims. You will handle claims through both the MOJ Portal and litigation process, with responsibility for progressing matters from initial instruction through to conclusion.

The role offers hybrid working, with two days per week based in the Bristol office and the remaining days working from home.

This is what you will be doing

As a Personal Injury Paralegal, your duties and responsibilities will include:-
- Managing your own caseload of claimant personal injury matters, including claims valued up to £25,000.
- Progressing claims both within and outside the MOJ Portal, including pre-litigation and litigated matters.
- Handling Fast Track claims through the litigation process, including issuing proceedings, complying with Court Directions and progressing matters towards Trial.
- Liaising regularly with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, solicitors and other third parties while managing client expectations.
- Maintaining accurate case records, meeting service standards and participating in regular case and risk assessment meetings.

The experience you will bring to the team

You will bring the following experience to the Personal Injury team:-
- Previous experience managing your own claimant personal injury caseload.
- A strong working knowledge of the MOJ Portal and Fast Track personal injury claims.
- Experience of litigation, including issuing proceedings, complying with Court Directions and progressing cases towards Trial.
- Strong communication, organisation and client-management skills, with the ability to prioritise a busy caseload effectively.
- A law degree, CILEx qualification or equivalent would be advantageous but is not essential where you can demonstrate relevant practical experience.

This is what you will get in return

You will receive a competitive salary up to £30,000 depending on experience, alongside a comprehensive benefits package including:
- Hybrid working, with only two days per week required in the Bristol office.
- Generous annual leave and employee welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan and gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Work-life balance initiatives and a flexible approach to workplace dress.
- Employee recognition and referral schemes.
- Training, development and routes towards further legal qualification.
- The opportunity to develop your career within an established national law firm and experienced claimant personal injury team.

Are you up to the challenge?

If you're a Personal Injury Paralegal ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch to find out more. All enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence by Yolk Recruitment. If you are looking to pursue the next step in your career with a highly regarded law firm, we encourage you to apply by contacting Oliver Coodye on or alternatively send your CV Yolk Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and embraces diversity in our workforce. We employ the best people for the job at hand and actively encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, sexual orientation, disability, educational background, parental status, gender identity or any other protected characteristic. We champion and celebrate diversity at Yolk allowing our team to bring their whole selves to work. Please note, whilst we do our best to contact all candidates, due to the high number of applications we receive we cannot guarantee this for every role. If you have not heard anything from us within 7 days of applying - then unfortunately you have been unsuccessful. Please keep an eye on our website for more opportunities.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
